Prefill pressure refers to the initial data loading from the model, which can be managed through prefillers to avoid latency. The decode tail handles the decoding of the output, ensuring efficient processing of the generated content. KV cache transfer involves transferring key-value pairs between the model and cache to minimize data movement. GPU scheduling ensures that the GPU resources are allocated dynamically to handle tasks in parallel. Autoscaling adjusts the number of GPUs or resources based on the workload, maintaining stability and efficiency. Each of these components is critical for maintaining the system's performance and resource utilization.
